policy: Bulk buy below 900 lb when affordable; passing-wagon buy below 90; hunt below 45 (adaptive: 90, hunting study: profile threshold); rest below 70 health or above 50 fatigue only with food. Adaptive holds $10 when buying food and sells supplies if blocked at toll. Hunting study watches worst individual health and provides care below 55 if an active condition and kit/cash available, at least 3 days apart; $10 cash reserve. Other batches no paid care. First affordable event choice; ferry or stage-appropriate crossing. Mixed/preservation profiles use two lb when well, three if any living traveler has a condition or internal health below 80. Preservation profiles process leftover fresh meat before buying/care; salt mode falls back to unsalted drying and attempts a salt purchase before hunting below five lb salt when cash >= $12. Stop at 365 days/2400 actions or unresolvable choice.
